answer_1.quote: FairPrism contains examples of text generated in both reply scenarios (e.g., autoreplies or chatbots) and continuation scenarios (e.g., writing emails or generating stories from a prompt).
answer_1.outputs: AI-generated text in reply and continuation scenarios

answer_4.quote: We used Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to collect FairPrism's annotations.
answer_4.guideline: We asked annotators to rate the extent of stereotyping and demeaning harms in the human input and the AI-generated output on a three-point not at all/somewhat/very scale, and to identify specific issues such as ignoring characteristics of demographic groups or attributing harmful views to named real-world sources.
criteria: attributing harmful views to named sources
